note: Model-specific categorization for crates/mlx-affine/examples/header_census.rs. It lives here, above the neutral crates, because a tensor-name prefix means nothing to safetensors-catalog or mlx-affine and must not start meaning something to them. The census runs without this file and simply reports no groups.
applies_to: PipeNetwork GLM-5.3-Flash-MLX-mixed-4_8bit and the same family

groups.name: vision
groups.why: The conversion recipe excludes the vision tower, so every tensor under this prefix is carried through as stored. Anything else under it is worth reporting.
